question: Does letting the ordinary decoder deliberate in its own words before the two-pass finisher selects an arithmetic program improve grounded answers on fresh human questions from two sources?
protocol: Independent primary. The published learned-exit reasoning decoder preserved an ordinary greedy prefix; the typed tool release can ground calls but often picks a wrong arithmetic operation. Start from pinned untouched Qwen Base only. Quantize the frozen first 23 layers and embedding to eight bits and use the shared BF16 final attention layer twice with rank-48 adapters. The unadapted ordinary view shares the same immutable arrays. On each of 512 training questions, generate up to 96 ordinary greedy thinking tokens from the actual schema-plus-user prompt. Switch before its first proposed end of thought, turn, message start or EOS. Preserve every emitted token. Fit the two-pass decoder on each true draft plus a short plan spelling out the publisher-derived operations, complete call, and a separate answer after the actual calculator callback. Use 960 seeded updates of eight full response targets. Evaluate on 24 ASDiv and 24 SVAMP human questions after blocking the first eight normalized words of any previously enrolled evaluation example. Training is 256 GSM8K and 256 MAWPS examples, each program executes to the published answer. Maximum training-to-test four-gram Jaccard with quantities masked is below .4. Both systems receive identical IDs, identical calculator schema, tools, greedy thinking-enabled 384-token allowance per turn and three-turn cap. For the candidate, the draft counts toward that first allowance, one output token is always reserved for the recurrent finisher, and the finisher handles the observation. No arithmetic extraction at inference. Use original strict and prose-tolerant numeric scoring plus independent grounding. Include both physical passes and repeated prefill in elapsed time. Record request-first and per-turn-first latencies separately.
gate: Require at least six additional correct final quantities overall, two-sided exact paired McNemar p<=.05, and a net gain of at least two in each source. Require no decline in strict quantities, completed replies, correct final tool results, or grounded replies in either source. Require at least 12 additional completed grounded requests overall. Total request time, summed first token per request and peak MLX memory may not increase. A miss closes this fit and all its descendants. Passing permits only an equally trained single-pass finisher using the same draft schedule and data; successful attribution then licenses an independent fresh human replication. Stop after this pair regardless of within-pair results.
